description: Use this to check a draw independently: recomputes the SHA-256 of a revealed server_seed against its hash, and the numbers of a swoge-hmac-sha256-v1 draw, or the 52-card shoe of a SWOGE casino hand (scheme swoge-casino-shoe with its nonce). Pure computation: nothing is stored.

client_seed.description: the client seed of the draw

numbers.description: optional; the numbers you were given, to compare

quote.description: true: return the price of this call without running or paying for it

server_seed_hash.description: optional; the hash published before the draw

name: fair_verify
title: fair verify
